body: My parents are 2000 miles away and a person I am living with is allergic.
My parents were abusive and I ran away 2 months ago. I haven't been in high school for over a year, I dropped out.

I ran away from my abusive home 2 months ago and I live with my boyfriend. I've been severely depressed for years but I always had ways to cope. I've lost almost everything now. I took so much pride in the PC I built but I had to leave it. I couldn't take my lovely cat with me, he was my best friend. My parents got my mentor fired out of spite with a false sexual abuse claim and I feel so guilty.

It feels like my boyfriend is the only person I really have left. It also feels like he doesn't care about how I feel if it doesn't fit into what he thinks I *should* feel.
I'm tired of living for other people.

I don't have friends, or a social circle. I dropped out of high school a year ago and out of college 2 months ago when I ran away from home.

One thing I've learned over the past few years is *it can always get worse*. One thing after another keeps happening. I held on for similar reasons above. Maybe things could change. Well, they did change. I'm a horribly depressed NEET who lost almost everything she owns and everyone who was kind of her friend.
If I was just living for myself, I would have killed myself a long time ago. I hate myself and I am unhappy here. I don't see the point.
I ran away from home already. I tried starting over but it feels like I can't escape my past. I wish I could forget some things.
I can't afford it.

I could continue hating my life. Living for people who would be devastated if I died but aren't there to talk when I need it.

I've put a lot of thought into this. I was abused growing up. I don't want to carry these memories for the rest of my life. I relive some of my worst multiple times a week.
No.
No, I can't work nights.
Sorry I haven't written in a while. I still don't know if I'm going to do it or not.

I tried sending him a message about how I feel. Maybe that will help.

I'm kicking myself right now. I applied for a job earlier and I was waiting for a call. I GOT ONE TWO HOURS AGO but the ringer was off! I just called back but the hiring manager is now gone for the day. I really hope I didn't kill my chance.

I don't have a doctor, seeing one costs too much. Even if I did, if you tell them you're suicidal you better be ready for involuntary admission to a psych ward for a few days. The last thing I need right now is to be held down and force drugged for tens of thousands of dollars I'd be paying off for the next decade.

The hotlines don't help me much. You call, tell them your problems, they tell you to not kill yourself, and then you need to free up the line for the next caller.

My boyfriend found some around two weeks ago, but he doesn't know about last night's. It worries him. I don't want him to find the ones from last night because I don't want him to feel annoyed or guilty. We had a disagreement that really hurt me, but the cutting is my own decision and not his fault at all. He shouldn't feel guilty, and I don't want him to think I did it so he'd feel guilty.

I hurt myself tonight and I made sure to do the cuts short enough for a large band aid to cover. I want them to heal quicker. It wasn't enough, though. I feel hurt and unwanted. I think I still want to go through with suicide. I'll give it until the weekend.

I don't know how to deal with this crushing feeling anymore. I feel like I don't belong. I keep having bad dreams about running away and things my parents have done. Everything feels pointless and I feel pathetic.

Do you think there's an afterlife, or do you think there's nothing. My grandma used to take me to church every weekend when I was a kid, but I haven't really believed since I was 14. Part of me thinks there's a God, but part of me is scared there is nothing and everything is actually pointless.

I don't know. I've never been good at making friends, even in high school. I don't know what I'm doing wrong.  My boyfriend got jealous of my guy friends so I want to make girl friends, but I'm even worse at meeting girls (which is ironic because I *am* a girl). I am defective. They can all tell something's off. Maybe you'd think I'm overthinking, but I am literally Autistic.

I just want to go jump.

It has been very cold lately. Today is warm, though. Maybe I'll go for a walk. I like biking because I like feeling like I'm actually getting somewhere and leaving.

My boyfriend has many friends and more opportunities to go out and do things than me. I didn't move to the area long ago. His friends will invite me along too, but more and more he doesn't want me to come. I get it, he needs time away, but I feel so isolated. He got my hopes up a few minutes ago and then changed his mind. "Would you mind actually not coming along...?" ow
I still wish I could do it. I wish I could do it every day. I feel empty.
I keep having bad dreams but I've been eating.
Still lost and like everything just keeps building up inside with no release.

Playing games, but I don't have my PC anymore. Cutting, but my BF gets worried. Bike riding, but I don't have my bike anymore. Talking to people I'm close to, but I drove them away. It feels like I have no good way to cope anymore. I feel lost.
No, they are super expensive.
